name: dev-commands
description: Zero-token slash commands: /ci (GitHub Actions runs), /antraege (Antrag status), /wp (git worktrees).

githubRepo.title: GitHub repository
githubRepo.description: owner/repo whose Actions runs /ci lists (public API, no token).

antraegeDir.title: Antraege directory
antraegeDir.description: Directory of Antrag Markdown files; its erledigt/ subfolder is read too.

closedStatuses.title: Closed statuses
closedStatuses.description: Comma-separated status values counted as closed. Empty: the built-in list.

repoDir.title: Repository directory
repoDir.description: Git checkout /wp reads. Empty: the session's working directory.
